title: Assistant/Associate Professor and Extension Specialist in Forest Business Resources
description:
Job Description

Overview

The College of Forestry, Wildlife, and Environment at Auburn
University invites applications for an Assistant/Associate
Professor and Extension Specialist in forest business/forest
economics. This is a tenure-track, 12-month appointment, with 65%
Extension and 35% teaching. The successful candidate will develop
an extramurally funded program to expand education, outreach, and
applied research in forest business resources for non-industrial
private forest landowners and the forest industry. The successful
candidate will perform the educational functions of the Alabama
Cooperative Extension System (ACES). In addition, the successful
candidate will develop a successful extramurally funded Extension
program with related applied research focusing on forest business
practices, including but not limited to economics, costs of
forestry practices, forest microenterprises and income-producing
opportunities, forest products and markets, economic development,
and forest management practices . Exceptionally qualified
candidates will be considered for the Harry E. Murphy Endowed
Professorship which provides a modest salary supplement and
additional operating funds.

Review of applications will begin on Aug 15, 2026, and continue
until a successful candidate has been identified. Applicants should
combine into one document a cover letter, curriculum vitae, names
and contact information of at least three references, statements of
teaching and research philosophies under the “Resume Upload”
section (maximum file size: 5MB). All other documents should be
uploaded under “Additional Documents.” For additional information
or questions contact: Dr. Mark Smith (mds0007@auburn.edu).

Responsibilities

The successful candidate is expected to work independently and in
collaboration with other faculty in the College of Forestry,
Wildlife, and Environment, Alabama Cooperative Extension System,
and other Auburn University faculty to: (1) develop and implement
undergraduate and graduate forestry and forest business programs
(2) work with stakeholders to develop applied research to address
the educational needs in Alabama and beyond, (3) develop and
deliver niche technical training and service programs for Regional
Extension Agents (REAs), organizations, private sector, and federal
agencies of Alabama and beyond, (4) secure extramural funding to
support programs, and (5) teach two to three courses per year and
mentor graduate students.

Qualifications

A PhD in forestry or a related field at the time employment begins.
The successful candidate must demonstrate a compelling interest and
capability to deliver science-based information to a variety of
audiences. Excellent written, organizational and communication
skills are required. Ability to act creatively, confidently, and
professionally when working with people from varied educational and
cultural backgrounds. Candidates must be willing and able to work
closely as a member of the Extension Forestry, Wildlife, and
Natural Resource team with universities, forest managers,
communities, and natural resource technical service providers.
Ability to travel, including a current unrestricted driver's
license, is also required. The successful candidate must meet
eligibility requirements for work in the United States at the time
the appointment is scheduled to begin and continue working legally
for the term of employment.

Minimum Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

N/A

Contract Type

Continuing
